definition: Erotic rasa (love) — in Bharata's system, one of nine rasas. In Kashmir Śaivism, śṛṅgāra is the sthāyibhāva (durable emotion) of love, evoked through vibhāva (determinants: separation, the beloved's absence) and anubhāva (consequents: the landscape answering the lover's mood). Abhinava added śāntarasa as the ninth; śṛṅgāra remains the most commonly discussed.

sources.claim: śṛṅgāra as one of eight (later nine) rasas; sthāyibhāva = rati (love)
śṛṅgāra as the rasa of love, with saṃyoga (union) and viyoga (separation) as its two forms

translations.note: 'Erotic' captures the rasa; 'love' is too broad. In aesthetics, śṛṅgāra is the relish of love, not love itself.
